# Current-gen Undercover. SpeedDebugOpt-enUS.h is the 360 debug build's (its SchemaVersion() is
# the retail 360 Vers); laid out naturally, its structs match the offsets of that build's PDB. The
# PC's and the 360's types have the same sizes, no bitfields and a 12-byte Vector3.
